camel_example: aliyun alb ListListeners --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key env --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I4FmYAXGKPd0000 --MaxResults 50 --Tag.1.Value product --LoadBalancerIds.1 'alb-bd6oylbckp6k9x0000' --ListenerProtocol HTTP --ListenerIds.1 'lsn-o4u54y73wq7b000000' --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the listeners in a region
kebab_example: aliyun alb list-listeners --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I4FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 50 --listener-ids lsn-o4u54y73wq7b000000 --load-balancer-ids alb-bd6oylbckp6k9x0000 --listener-protocol HTTP --tag Value=product Key=env --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListListeners

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
If a value is returned for NextToken, you must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. This parameter is optional. Valid values: 1 to 100. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 20 is used
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量，此参数为可选参数。取值范围：1~100。入参为空时，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The listener IDs. You can specify at most 20 listener IDs
parameters.help_zh: 监听实例ID列表。最多支持20个监听ID
parameters.name: listener_ids

parameters.help_en: The ALB instance ID. You can specify at most 20 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例ID。最多支持20个实例ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_ids

parameters.help_en:
The listener protocol. Valid values:

HTTP
HTTPS
QUIC
parameters.help_zh:
需要过滤的监听协议。取值：

HTTP：协议类型为HTTP。
HTTPS：协议类型为HTTPS。
QUIC：协议类型为QUIC
parameters.name: listener_protocol

fields.help_en: The tag key. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: value
